## Hummingway

Hummingway is Fluttershy's tiny green hummingbird friend in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. He's easiest to recognize as the bird who sings along with Fluttershy while she tries to cheer up Princess Celestia's phoenix, Philomena. Look for a darker green back and wings, pale green underside, and long, needlelike beak.

[![Hummingway on Fluttershy's hoof](https://derpicdn.net/img/2023/4/6/3096443/full.png)](https://derpibooru.org/images/3096443)

*Show still from “A Bird in the Hoof”; production: Hasbro Studios. The linked image post provides its context and tags.*

**Name and voice.** Fluttershy says his name in the show, so he isn't just a fan-named background bird. “Hummingway” is a pun on *hummingbird* and *Hemingway*; one [episode transcript](https://www.springfieldspringfield.co.uk/view_episode_scripts.php?episode=s01e22&tv-show=my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic) also brackets “Hemingway” as a possible rendering, not a distinct identity. He chirps, twitters, and hums rather than speaking words; no individual voice actor was verified. His return and name are also recorded in the [“Maud Pie” transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Maud_Pie_%28episode%29).

**Verified appearances:** “A Bird in the Hoof” (S1E22) and “Maud Pie” (S4E18). This is Fluttershy's animal companion, not a pony or a disguised character.

## Important moments

- **The recovered patient helps Philomena — “A Bird in the Hoof” (S1E22).** Fluttershy recalls nursing Hummingway back to health, then brings him to greet the ailing-looking phoenix; his musical exchange with Fluttershy demonstrates her affectionate bond with animals. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=coG1-9pt4Ck). *Scene timestamp unavailable: the upload's timing was not independently verified.*
- **A cheerful greeting on Maud's visit — “Maud Pie” (S4E18).** Hummingway tweets hello during the woodland outing; Fluttershy translates his greeting for Pinkie Pie, who playfully tries speaking hummingbird herself. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O4g4YWVqczE). *Scene timestamp unavailable: the upload's timing was not independently verified.*
